# Malachi Chapter 3 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A) | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/MAL_003_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

**3:1** "Behold, I [am] sending [shole'ach] my-messenger [malakhi], and-he-will-prepare [u-finnah] the-way [derekh] before-me [lefanai]; and-suddenly [u-fit'om] will-come [yavo] to his-temple [hekhalo] the-Lord [ha-Adon] whom you-seek [mevaqqshim]; and-the-messenger [u-malakh] of-the-covenant [ha-berit] whom you-desire [chafetsim] — behold, he-comes [ba]," says YHWH of-Hosts.

**3:10** "Bring [havi'u] all the-tithe [ha-ma'aser] to the-storehouse [beit ha-otzar], and-let-there-be [vihi] food [terep] in-my-house [beiti]; and-test-me [u-vechanuni] now [na] in-this," says YHWH of-Hosts, "if [im] I-will-not open [eftach] for-you the-windows [arubbot] of-the-heavens and-pour-out [vaharioqthi] for-you blessing [berakhah] until [ad] there-is-not-enough [beli dai]."
